plan.title: Add Surrogate Bid to eRFX RFQ

steps.note: Open the prepared event directly on the RFQ Participants tab, avoiding event creation or list search.
Enable eRFX project features required by the case.
Enable surrogate bidding after an existing bid as required by the case configuration.
Verify Vendor A is invited and offers the Add Bid control.
Enter and submit the buyer's surrogate bid for Vendor A; the default price is used because none was specified.
Confirm the surrogate bid was accepted and submitted.
Verify the RFQ Responses view shows the new surrogate response alongside the existing direct bid.
Open the comparison grid where the bid ranking is displayed.
Verify both bidder columns, including the surrogate bidder, are present with real vendor names.
Verify the bids are ranked in Master QCS.
